name: FDJ United
summary: FDJ United is a company primarily focused on the management and distribution of various gaming and gambling services, operating both within France and internationally. Its business activities are organized into three main segments: Lottery, Sports Betting and Online Gaming (which includes competitive market offerings), and a division for other miscellaneous operations. The company's diverse offerings include a variety of lottery products, such as traditional draw games and instant-win scratch cards, accessible through both physical points of sale and digital channels. It also provides sports wagering services at retail locations, complemented by extensive online platforms for sports betting, horse racing, poker, and casino games, prominently featuring its Unibet and 32Red brands. Beyond gaming, FDJ United manages local collection and payment solutions, and handles the printing of its lottery tickets. Founded in 1933, the company, whose headquarters are located in Boulogne-Billancourt, France, was formerly known as La Française des Jeux Société anonyme before officially rebranding to FDJ United in March 2025.
